description:
Return speaker turns overlapping [start_ms, end_ms] with their text, for checking context.

        A turn with cluster null and speaker "No speaker label" holds words no voice was found for. The words are as
        heard; don't attribute them to a neighbouring speaker.

        Not available for official transcripts without timing (timing_granularity "document"): read those at the
        result's document_url, or resolve the citation for the surrounding turns.

end_ms.description: End, in milliseconds; at most 5 minutes after start_ms.
end_ms.title: End Ms

start_ms.description: Start, in milliseconds from the start of the video, e.g. an instance's start_ms minus 30000.
start_ms.title: Start Ms

name: govtube_get_transcript_window
title: Read transcript around a moment
